title: Shared atoms (vocabulary) for Orthodox service data
description: Single source of truth for shared concepts: Tone, Speaker, Hymn, Troparion, Kontakion, Prokeimenon, Alleluia, CanonOde, ServiceBlock, StructureBlock, SaintCategory, FeastRank. Referenced by all per-file schemas under schemas/.

Meta.title: Authoring metadata (free-form escape hatch)
Meta.description: Free-form _meta object. Conventionally holds description, source, sourceUrl, note, author, tone, feast, feastRank, feastType. Not enforced — authors may add any keys.

Tone.title: Liturgical tone
Tone.description: Octoechos tone, integer 0-8. 0 = no tone / read silently. null = not applicable (e.g., responses, rubrics).

DotPath.title: Dot-notation key into fixed-texts (e.g., prayers.ourFather)
DotPath.description: Optional 'prefix:' namespace for cross-document refs (typika:opening.foo). Hyphens allowed in segments.

SaintCategory.title: Saint commemoration category (open enum)
SaintCategory.description: Category used for general-menaion fallback, propers selection, and rank inference. NOT enforced as a closed enum — new categories surface over years. v1.1 will lock based on observed values after 30 days.

FeastRank.title: Liturgical rank of the commemoration (open enum)
FeastRank.description: Rank governs assembler decisions (entrance, kathisma, lauds, polyeleos secondary propers, etc.). NOT enforced as closed enum — boundary cases (vigil vs polyeleos) are occasionally fluid. v1.1 will lock based on observed values after 30 days.

Hymn.title: A generic hymn (sticheron, troparion-like)
Hymn.description: Minimal shape: an object. Text is normally present but may be omitted on a 'repeat' sticheron (sing the previous one with a different verse).

Troparion.title: Troparion — short summary hymn for a feast or saint

Kontakion.title: Kontakion — paired with troparion, often with ikos

ikos.description: Either a plain text string or an {text, label} object.

BothNow.title: Theotokion at the 'Now and ever' slot
BothNow.description: Appears after a saint's Glory in many sections. Shape mirrors Hymn but kept as a distinct atom for clarity.

Prokeimenon.title: Versicle + verse sung before a reading

CanonOde.title: One ode of a canon (irmos + troparia, optional katavasia)
CanonOde.description: irmos2/irmos3 present when joining a second/third canon at this ode. troparia may include theotokia inline. Both irmos and troparia are optional in v1 — afterfeast canons can defer irmos to a parent feast canon, and feast-Matins overlays can have irmos-only odes (troparia from the feast canon).

StructureBlock.title: A block in a service-structure skeleton (the input)
StructureBlock.description: Lives in service-structure/*.json. type='fixed' points into fixed-texts via textKey. type='variable' resolves at runtime via resolvedBy + sources.

ServiceBlock.title: A rendered output block (assembler emits these)
ServiceBlock.description: Documented in CLAUDE.md. Used by renderers + e2e tests. Not authored directly — emitted by assemblers.
